facts.label: Tesla 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders
facts.summary: Thu 3 Dec 2026, 3:00 p.m. CT (21:00 UTC / 21:00 Dublin). Virtual meeting at virtualshareholdermeeting.com/TSLA2026; limited in-person at Giga Texas. Record date 13 Oct 2026. In-person drawing deadline was Fri 6 Nov 2026, 11:59 p.m. CT; selections go out the week of 16 Nov. Source: votetesla.com/annual-meeting-details/ (checked 9 Nov 2026).

facts.label: Tesla 2026 Annual Meeting in-person drawing deadline
facts.summary: Past: the deadline to enter Tesla’s random drawing for limited in-person seats at the 3 Dec 2026 Annual Meeting was Fri 6 Nov 2026, 11:59 p.m. CT. Selections are communicated the week of 16 Nov.

facts.label: Starship Flight 16
facts.summary: December 2026 target, reported. FAA CADENA air-traffic planning slides (22 Oct) list Flight 16 NET 10 Dec 2026, as the first flight from Florida (LC-39A). NASASpaceflight (25 Oct) estimates the first LC-39A Starship flight could be in late January 2027. This is reporting, not a SpaceX date.

facts.label: Starship Flight 15
facts.summary: SpaceX is targeting Flight 15 as soon as Friday 13 November from Pad 2, pending regulatory approval. The 75-minute window opens at 4:45 p.m. CT (22:45 UTC). Ship 42 moved to the pad on 12 Nov (SpaceX, 13 Nov 00:56 UTC). Planned: first Super Heavy V3 catch, first Ship return-to-launch-site catch, 26 Starlink V3, then a more than 22-hour flight before a Ship catch. This is a published window, not a guaranteed T-0. No FAA licence is published. Re-checked 13 Nov 2026.

facts.label: Dragon · CRS-35 docked with the ISS
facts.source: NASA space station blog, 15 Oct 2026: docked at 10:27 a.m. EDT
facts.summary: Docked 10:27 a.m. EDT to Harmony’s space-facing port with 6,300+ lb of cargo and the final IROSA pair. About 30 minutes ahead of the ~11:00 a.m. ET plan.

facts.label: Tesla Roadster reveal
facts.summary: Past: Tesla revealed the next-gen Roadster on 15 Oct (16 Oct Irish time). Replay and write-up on the Dispatch.

facts.label: SpaceX Q3 2026 earnings call
facts.summary: Past: SpaceX reported Q3 2026 revenue of $14.58B and net income of $4.40B after the US close on Tue 20 Oct, then held its webcast at 3:30 p.m. CT. Replay on ir.spacex.com; write-up on the Dispatch.

facts.label: Tesla Q3 2026 earnings call
facts.summary: Past: Tesla reported Q3 2026 revenue of $28.05B, GAAP net income of $787M and free cash flow of $1.53B after the US close on Wed 21 Oct, then held its Q&A webcast at 4:30 p.m. CT. Replay on ir.tesla.com; write-up on the Dispatch.

facts.label: Falcon 9 · USSF-481
facts.summary: Liftoff ~5:02 p.m. PT (00:02 UTC 16 Oct); first stage landed on Of Course I Still Love You.

facts.label: Falcon 9 · Bandwagon-5 rideshare
facts.summary: Launched Tue 20 Oct at 7:04 a.m. ET from SLC-40, Cape Canaveral, with 32 payloads incl. SpaceX's second Starfall demo. The first stage, on its 19th flight, landed on A Shortfall of Gravitas.

facts.label: SpaceX lock-up release · up to 1.3B shares
facts.summary: Up to 1.3 billion SPCX shares (28% of the 180-day lock-up pool) became eligible for sale from the second full Nasdaq trading day after Q3 results, per the 424B4 prospectus. With results after the close on Tue 20 Oct, that was Thu 22 Oct.
